FN-FYFGDCD-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 212
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Jack Williams
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/19/2024
Senate Bill 212 as introduced proposes an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama 2022
that, if ratified, would allow the University of Mobile to de-annex from the corporate limits of
the municipality in which it currently resides. This bill would increase the proclamation
expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the
fiscal year ending September 30, 2025.
Page 1
